description: This file defines the 'Image_Graph_Fill_Array' class, which manages a sequential array of fill styles for graphical elements within the 'Image_Graph' package. It includes methods for adding fill styles or colors, resetting the fill array, and retrieving the current fill style. The class is used to handle multiple fill styles for various objects in a graph rendering context.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Fill_Array
classes.description: A sequential array of fill styles used for filling multiple objects within a graph element. Supports adding various fill styles and retrieving them in sequence.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the sequence to the beginning by resetting internal pointer to the fill styles array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new fill style object to the array, optionally associating it with an ID tag.

methods.name: addColor
methods.description: Adds a color value to the fill styles array, optionally with an ID tag.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the current fill style, handling object types and fallback to parent method if necessary.
